corrections.desc: Words the TCP transcription misread or left out, corrected to the 1675 print (archive.org bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_the-nature-power-decei_owen-john_1675).

p. 8 (scan 16): '(saith he) evil is present with me', Rom 7:21; both OCRs 'evil'
p. 39 (scan 47): 'not one whit the more satisfied, than if he had received nothing'
p. 49 (scan 57): 'embrace any diversion, though it wound it self thereby'
p. 165 (scan 173): 'the beauty and usefulness of the fruit to make one wise'
p. 253 (scan 261): 'then is Satans time to attempt a re-entrance'
p. 273 (scan 281): 'of bringiug glory to God' (bringiug as printed)
